name: LILYGO T-Echo-Lite L76K GPS Expansion Module User Manual
snippet: Comprehensive instruction manual for the LILYGO T-Echo-Lite L76K GPS Expansion Module, featuring SX1262 LoRa, NRF52840 MCU, and 1.22-inch E-Paper display. Learn setup, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting for your Meshtastic-compatible device.

name: L76K GPS Module - Waveshare Wiki
snippet: The first positioning of the module (cold start), under normal circumstances (outdoors, good weather, no large building block), takes 35 seconds to successfully locate, please wait patiently.

name: LILYGO® TTGO T-Echo devices - Meshtastic

name: L76K GPS Module - Waveshare Wiki
snippet: L76K 是一款支持多卫星系统（GPS、BeiDou、GLONASS、QZSS）、可多系统联合定位和单系统独立定位、支持AGNSS 功能、内置低噪声放大器和声表面滤波器、可向用户提供快速、精准、高性能定位体验的 GNSS 模块。 本模块提供树莓派、Arduino、Raspberry Pi Pico、ESP32控制例程。
